ITEM 1 | Bagel-shaped round roll, pale golden-tan crust with a central hole, topped and filled with a thick, opaque, creamy white spread with slight peaks and small flecks of green herb, covering most of the roll's top surface; roll about 9 cm across, spread about 2 cm thick at center | 130
ITEM 2 | Cluster of roasted cubed vegetable pieces, about 2 to 3 cm each, with browned, slightly caramelized edges and a dull, matte surface; a mix of dark purple-brown skin pieces and pale yellow-orange flesh with visible golden-tan roasted patches; pieces are irregular chunks with some folded edges, sitting on the plate to the left of the roll and partly touching it | 110
ITEM 3 | Dark brown, slightly glossy chunky pieces with purple-brown skin and a soft, moist-looking interior, roughly 2 to 3 cm, scattered among the other cubes at the lower left of the cluster; no visible sauce, edges appear lightly charred | 45
